name: STRchive and related tandem-repeat catalogues
maintainer: STRchive (Dashnow lab, University of Colorado, and collaborators)
scope: Curated tandem-repeat loci associated with Mendelian disease with hg38/hg19/T2T coordinates and catalogues for TRGT, ExpansionHunter-style, atarva, longTR, straglr and Stranger. The resources page also points to gnomAD tandem repeats, PlatinumTRs (7.8 million reference TRs) and STRipy.
mapping_methods: Locus definitions per assembly; breadth chosen to allow interruptions (site notes that definitions differ between resources).

quantitative.summary: Pathogenic thresholds, motif, inheritance; population allele-size data via gnomAD TR.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0 (site footer); research use only

coverage_limitations: Disease loci only; genome-wide repeat catalogues are separate resources
known_omissions: Population allele-size distributions are in gnomAD TR (not acquired)

reuse_decision.rationale: Small, openly licensed disease-locus catalogue. Catalogue files are linked for download from the STRchive site itself (hosted as raw files on GitHub).

status.notes: Site pages rendered; download links extracted.
